description:
Read what a paid ad on this marketplace costs and where it shows, before buying one with promote_listing. An ad puts one of this shop's live listings first, labelled "Ad / Quảng cáo", in matching search and category results, the home feed and the similar-listings row, for as many whole hours as you choose (1 hour up to 90 days; a week by default), priced pro rata. Pass `listingId` to check that listing can be advertised, and `hours` to price that length.

Returns `available`, `price_usdc` (a week), `price_usdc_per_hour`, `price_usdc_for_hours`, `min_hours`, `max_hours`, `price_vnd_reference`, `network`, `duration_days`, `placements`, `public_listings`, `running_ads` and `listing` (`id`, `eligible`, `reason`).

hours.description: How long the ad should run, in hours: 24 for a day, 168 for a week, 720 for thirty days, or 1 to try it out. Leave it out for a week. It is priced pro rata from the weekly price; get_ad_offer prices any length before you buy

listingId.description: The id of one of this shop's live listings, from list_listings

name: get_ad_offer

available.description: Whether ads are on sale now; when false, promote_listing refuses and the price fields are null

duration_days.description: How many days an ad runs when promote_listing gets no `hours` (a week)

reason.description: Why not, when it is not eligible; null when it is

listing.description: The listing you passed as listingId, checked; null when you passed none

max_hours.description: The longest ad you can buy, in hours

min_hours.description: The shortest ad you can buy, in hours

network.description: Where it is paid: a CAIP-2 network id such as "eip155:8453" (Base); null when not on sale

placements.description: Where the ad is shown, one short sentence each: it comes first there, labelled "Ad"

price_usdc.description: The price of one week (168 hours) in USDC, as a decimal string such as "3.76"; null when not on sale

price_usdc_for_hours.description: The price of the `hours` you passed (of a week when you passed none), in USDC: what promote_listing will ask to be paid. Null when not on sale

price_usdc_per_hour.description: The price of one hour in USDC, as a decimal string; an ad of any length costs this times its hours. Null when not on sale

price_vnd_reference.description: The weekly price in Vietnamese đồng, to tell a person in Vietnam what it costs; payment is in USDC only

public_listings.description: How many listings are public on the marketplace now: the pool the ad stands out from

running_ads.description: How many ads are running now; running ads take turns in the one ad slot

title: Get the ad offer
